market_ready.hands_on_task: Blog REST API: Spring Boot + PostgreSQL + JWT + Swagger. CRUD posts/comments với phân trang, full-text search

questions.question: @Transactional Spring hoạt động như thế nào?

options.A: Proxy AOP: wrap method trong DB transaction, auto rollback nếu RuntimeException

questions.explanation: @Transactional: proxy-based AOP. Self-invocation không hoạt động. Dùng propagation: REQUIRED (default), REQUIRES_NEW, NESTED.

questions.question: @Bean vs @Component khác nhau?

options.A: @Bean: define trong @Configuration class cho third-party objects. @Component: annotate your own class

questions.explanation: @Component/@Service/@Repository: stereotype annotations cho class bạn viết. @Bean: trong @Configuration method, dùng khi configure third-party libraries (DataSource, RestTemplate).

academic.summary: @Entity, @OneToMany, @ManyToMany, JPQL, @Query, specifications, N+1 problem, lazy/eager loading

market_ready.hands_on_task: Fix N+1 problem trong entity với @OneToMany relationships. Implement dynamic queries với JPA Specifications

questions.question: N+1 problem trong JPA xảy ra thế nào và fix ra sao?

options.A: Lazy load relationships trong vòng lặp → N queries. Fix: @EntityGraph, JOIN FETCH, @BatchSize

questions.explanation: 1 query lấy N entities. Trong vòng lặp access lazy relation → N queries. Fix: @EntityGraph(attributePaths={'comments'}) hoặc JPQL: SELECT p FROM Post p JOIN FETCH p.comments.

academic.summary: SecurityFilterChain, UserDetailsService, JWT filter, RBAC, method security @PreAuthorize, OAuth2

market_ready.hands_on_task: Implement JWT auth trong Spring Boot: register/login, access+refresh tokens, role-based access (@PreAuthorize), token blacklisting

questions.question: Spring Security filter chain hoạt động như thế nào?

options.A: Request đi qua chain filters, mỗi filter có thể reject hoặc pass. Authentication filter extract token, Authorization filter check permissions

questions.explanation: DelegatingFilterProxy → FilterChainProxy → SecurityFilterChain (ordered list). Key filters: CorsFilter, JwtAuthenticationFilter (custom), UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter, ExceptionTranslationFilter, FilterSecurityInterceptor.
